competitors.name: Hy-Vee / Prodx
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported Hy-Vee is using Prodx to structure and enrich nearly 265,000 products across its online shopping platform, standardizing an average of seven attributes per SKU across more than 1,200 attribute types and 5,800 active categories. The product data supports buy-again, substitutions, personalization, recommendations and digital merchandising.

competitors.name: AppCard / independent grocers
competitors.action: Supermarket News reported AppCard launched a Digital Circular that uses its Pinky AI to convert static weekly ads into clickable circulars. Sale-item clicks can trigger recipes from a library of more than 6,500 recipes and add required ingredients to a shopping list, while offsite ads can be targeted using spend patterns, ZIP code and POS data.

competitors.name: Specialty Food Association / Summer Fancy Food Show brands
competitors.action: The Specialty Food Association's Trendspotter Panel said specialty food innovation is applying global flavors to familiar comfort formats, citing butter chicken frozen pizza and beef shawarma pizza as examples. The panel also called out bite-sized premium formats, ingredient-forward positioning and craft aesthetics as emerging specialty food signals.

trends.magnitude: Hy-Vee/Prodx structured nearly 265,000 products across 1,200+ attribute types and 5,800 active categories
trends.context: Regional grocers are making digital product attributes a merchandising asset. Real Dough should keep frozen pizza data complete for retailer search, substitutions, diet flags, prep guidance and recommendation engines.

trends.magnitude: AppCard's new circular links sale items to 6,500+ recipes and shopping-list adds
trends.context: Weekly ads are becoming shoppable meal-planning surfaces. Premium frozen pizza promotions may need to work inside recipe, basket-building and offsite retail-media contexts, not only freezer-door signage.

trends.topic: Global comfort-food premiumization in specialty frozen
trends.magnitude: SFA trendspotters cited butter chicken frozen pizza and beef shawarma pizza among globalized comfort examples
trends.context: Specialty buyers are looking for differentiated familiar formats. Real Dough can watch whether premium frozen pizza innovation shifts from crust/process claims alone toward globally inspired toppings and restaurant-style experiences.
